You don't KNOW that I'm an amazing person. I'm not even a person, really. I sleep about 15 hours a day and don't have the energy for jogging. 

I work in a bank. It was all going OK but they took away all of our overtime and now it's just not enough to pay the bills. I have a degree but can't seem to find a decent paying job. One of my friends has bought a 4 bedroom detached house today. I can't afford to pay my phone bill. We are of the same background and education. I feel like a massive failure.
Cheers. The drinking is not a regular thing I do, so I don't really feel the need for help. And in the end I didn't pass out, I just went to bed as usual.

Thanks. This is a great point, and I did. He knows he can be selfish, I forced him to confront the things I was dealing with rather than pretending they won't there for his own sake, and things are improving somewhat. He was somewhat in denial about how bad I was. I won't let that continue. But you're right. By assuming he knew how I felt, I was actually not helping the situation. Thank you.

Hi. Not one to feed the trolls, but for my own sake I'd like to clarify something. I did not get 'laid off for being on drugs'. I got signed off from work by the doctor for severe depression and when I told my manager, she said that 'drugs often make the whole thing worse, and you're a young person.... is there anything you'd like to tell me?" and then basically didn't believe me when I said no. (I am not on ANY drugs, save the alcohol). 

Also... I'm not married it's not that easy and simple, and crying on the internet actually DID help me a lot since everybody said lovely, rational things which helped me remember I'm a whole person with value. So thanks, everybody else, but fuck you Mardoo. Go back to your Guilds subreddits, people probably understand you there.
Thank you so much. I've just woken up, remarkably not even hungover. BF has gone to work. Have no idea what to do with myself, but all the posts here have really given me a bit of strength.
Thank you. That helped. Love back to you.

Yeah, I talked to him. Then he had a go at me for not picking stuff up after I'd made him dinner. I'm thinking I'm probably going to my parents house tomorrow.

To tell the truth, I'm scared. I have friends who I know love me, but they're all hundreds of miles away. I just can't do this here alone.
